description_en: Changes the billing method of a PolarDB cluster
kebab_example: aliyun polardb transform-db-cluster-pay-type --db-cluster-id pc-bp10gr51qasnl0000 --pay-type Prepaid --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: TransformDBClusterPayType

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of the instance. Valid values:

Postpaid: pay-as-you-go

Prepaid: subscription
parameters.help_zh:
实例的付费类型。取值：

Postpaid：后付费（按量付费）

Prepaid：预付费（包年包月）
parameters.name: pay_type

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration. Valid values:

If Period is set to Year, set UsedTime to a value from 1 to 3.

If Period is set to Month, set UsedTime to a value from 1 to 9.

This parameter is required when PayType is set to Prepaid
parameters.help_zh:
购买时长，取值：

当Period为Year时，UsedTime取值为1~3。

当Period为Month时，UsedTime取值为1~9。

当PayType取值Prepaid时，需要传入该参数
parameters.name: used_time

parameters.help_en:
The subscription type of the subscription instance. Valid values:

Year: yearly subscription

Month: monthly subscription

This parameter is required when PayType is set to Prepaid
parameters.help_zh:
指定预付费实例为包年或者包月类型。取值：

Year：包年

Month：包月

当PayType取值为Prepaid时，需要传入该参数
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The value of this parameter is generated by the client and must be unique among different requests. The token is case-sensitive and cannot exceed 64 ASCII characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 该参数用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，保证在不同请求间该参数值的唯一性。该参数区分大小写、长度不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically use coupons. Valid values:
true (default): Use coupons.
false: Do not use coupons
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动使用优惠券，取值：
true（默认）：使用优惠券。
false：不使用优惠券
parameters.name: auto_use_coupon

parameters.help_en: The coupon code. If you do not specify this parameter, the default coupon is used
parameters.help_zh: 优惠券编号，不填时使用默认优惠券
parameters.name: promotion_code

ChargeType.description_en:
The billing method of the instance. Valid values:

Postpaid: pay-as-you-go

Prepaid: subscription
ChargeType.description_zh:
实例的付费类型。取值：

Postpaid：后付费（按量付费）

Prepaid：预付费（包年包月）

ExpiredTime.description_en:
The expiration time of the instance.
This response parameter is returned only when PayType is set to Prepaid
ExpiredTime.description_zh:
实例的到期时间。
当PayType取值为Prepaid时，才支持该返回参数
